title: Pan-Seared Canadian Portobello Mushrooms
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared portobello mushrooms, perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the unique oil to the skillet and let it heat up for a minute.
Add the portobello mushrooms to the skillet, gill side down.
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the mushrooms develop a nice brown color on the gill side.
Flip the mushrooms over and cook for another 3-4 minutes or until they're tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
If using crispy breadcrumbs, sprinkle them on top of the mushrooms.
Serve the mushrooms hot and enjoy!
